seo.title: Management Software for Dentists
seo.description: The all-in-one SaaS platform for modern dentists. Manage patient records, clinical sessions, and earnings with ease.

hero.subtitle: DentStory is the all-in-one clinical  designed for Dentists. Manage patients, analyze revenue, and showcase your portfolio.
hero.installPwaToast: App is already installed, or your browser requires manual installation (Share > Add to Home Screen).

howItWorks.title: See DentStory
howItWorks.subtitle: Watch this quick demo to see how easy it is to manage your clinics, patients, portfolio, and financial records all in one place.

portfolioShowcase.subtitle: Turn your everyday sessions into a public professional storefront. DentStory automatically builds a beautiful, SEO-optimized portfolio from your clinical records to share with patients and peers.

features.title: DentStory features.
features.subtitle: Every feature in DentStory is designed to solve a friction point in the surgical and clinical workflow. Zero fluff, maximum performance.

patientDirectory.title: Smart Patient Directory
patientDirectory.desc: Centralized patient records with medical alerts, insurance tracking, and instant search. Your entire practice, organized.

procedureLogging.title: Session & Procedure Logging
procedureLogging.desc: Log treatment categories, clinical notes, and session costs in seconds. No more messy notebooks or lost records.

mediaLibrary.title: Clinical Media Library
mediaLibrary.desc: Securely upload X-rays and clinical photos directly to patient sessions. Build a visual timeline of every patient case.

portfolioGen.title: Generate your Portfolio
portfolioGen.desc: Instantly generate a public professional portfolio. Showcase your best clinical results to patients and medical partners, and easily share it with anyone as your CV.

revenueAnalytics.title: Revenue Analytics
revenueAnalytics.desc: Visualize your monthly earnings, patient growth, and top treatments with interactive financial dashboards.

multiClinic.title: Multi-Clinic Switching
multiClinic.desc: Manage multiple clinics with unique commission and independent revenue tracking in one workspace.

whatsappSync.title: WhatsApp Quick-Sync
whatsappSync.desc: Directly message patients from their card. Pre-fill follow-up notes and appointment reminders with one tap.

pricing.subtitle: DentStory is built by a dentist for the surgical family. We don't believe in limits or high access fees for critical clinical data.

finalMission.title: Ready to take your career to the next level?
finalMission.subtitle: Join the clinical family today. Streamline your sessions, track your growth, and showcase your expertise in one beautiful workspace.
